messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU capacity exhaustion detected in prod-east-1 (cluster inference-prod-1). Queue length for /v1/generate has spiked to 12k, autoscaler failing to add nodes. Error seen in CA logs: "error attaching instance profile: Rate exceeded". Pager routed to infra-oncall.

sara (oncall): I'm on it, looking at cluster-autoscaler logs now. Can someone check ASG desired/limit for gpu-nodegroup-prod-east?

mike (infra): grabbing ASG info — showing max size 40, desired 40, current instances 40. No capacity left in the ASG. Also see repeated AttachRoleWithAmazonEC2 throttles in CloudTrail (HTTP 429).

aj (sre): CA log excerpt: ```I0321 22:01:03 scaler.go:430] Failed to create node: error while creating instance: AttachRolePolicy failed: Rate exceeded``` repeated 150x. CA is backing off. Queue size -> 12k, tail latency >> 15s for GPU-backed requests.

leo (mlops): Customer impact: a few high-volume customers on LLM-productions are seeing 503s and huge latency. Support ticket count +17 in last 10m. Marking as Sev2 until we confirm sizing.

anita (support): Noted. Ticket #INC-2546 linked. Customer A reports timeouts, Customer B degraded responses. I'll update status page and set message: "We are investigating elevated latency for model generation in prod-east-1."

infra-oncall: Quick mitigation options: 1) increase ASG max/desired to open capacity (need approval for extra instances), 2) create a parallel nodegroup with a different launch template (different instance profile) to avoid attach role rate cap, 3) manually provision GPUs via separate pool. Which path do we take?

sara (oncall): Short term: create temp nodegroup w/ pre-baked launch template that uses a recently rotated instance profile (less throttled). Meanwhile, scale down nonessential GPU jobs (batch training) to free capacity. I'll attempt nodegroup create now.

mike (infra): Creating nodegroup prod-east-gpu-temp-1 with LT v3, instance profile arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/redwood-ec2-v2. Note: API is returning throttling on CreateFleet sometimes, retrying.

incident-bot: System: new nodegroup create triggered by sara at 22:05 UTC. Status: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS.

aj (sre): Found another constraint: account-level LaunchTemplateCreate limit approaching. If we create LT v3 we may hit create throttles too. Suggest reuse an existing LT but swap instance profile with a secondary profile that has attach permissions.

leo (mlops): Also spin up a temporary CPU-only fallback path for non-critical traffic: route lower-priority customers to CPU model endpoints to preserve GPU capacity for paying customers. Can we switch routing quickly?

sara (oncall): Adding routing rule now. Pushing a rapid feature flag: route-inference:gpu-priority -> true for top customers, fallback for others.

mike (infra): Nodegroup creation eventually succeeds but nodes are stuck in Pending because LaunchTemplate version mismatch with our ASG constraints. Error in node logs: ```Instance launch failed: Unsupported parameter in launch template: Taint:gpu=true``` (we use taints in bootstrap). Trying a manual patch to remove taint from launch template user-data to get nodes to register then taint from kube side.

aj (sre): CA now reports several scale-up attempts but instances are not joining due to kubelet register failing (IMDSv2 tokens dropped during attach retry). Doing `kubectl get nodes` shows 0 new GPU nodes.

mike (infra): Manual w orkaround: launching EC2 instances from console with same AMI and instance profile. They bounced in and joined the cluster as NotReady -> Ready after docker runtime started. Once joined, we can label/taint correctly. Launching 3 this way as emergency.

sara (oncall): Thanks. While that finishes, reduce parallelism of generation API: set per-worker concurrency from 16 -> 6 and enable per-route rate limit to throttle new requests. This will buy us ~60-90s per request increase but reduce queue growth. Deployed policy now.

anita (support): Status update posted on status page and to customers: short blurb with ETA 30m. Customers asked for timeline.

leo (mlops): Quick check: autoscaler config has scaleUpDelay and webhook timeouts set low, CA is retrying frequently and getting throttled. We should increase CA backoff and add exponential retry. Also add jitter on CreateFleet calls.

incident-bot: Note: manual instances joined cluster at 22:18 UTC. 3 GPU nodes registered and Ready. Queue dropped from 12k -> 7k, tail latency improving.

mike (infra): Still seeing AttachRole RateExceeded on remaining auto-created instances. AWS account has attach role API limits; I'm opening a ticket with AWS support but that will take time. Need longer-term mitigation: pre-attach instance-profile to instances or warm instance profiles via small pre-creates.

aj (sre): Added a temporary autoscaler override: allow fallback to smaller GPU SKU (g5 -> g4) which are easier to provision in region. Rolling CA policy update now.

ana?: (typo)

sara (oncall): Handoff for next oncall (infra-oncall): summary: root cause - AttachRole API rate caps + ASG at max desired -> autoscaler failed to add nodes; launch template/user-data taint mismatch blocked some nodes; mitigation - manual EC2 launches, temp nodegroup with alternate instance profile, routing fallback to CPU models, throttling concurrency; ongoing - AWS support ticket for rate increase, create pre-warmed pool, update launchtemplate/version pin and CA retry behavior. Next oncall please monitor queue and ASG desired/instances and customer tickets.

infra-oncall: Taking handoff. Quick notes: monitor `kubectl get pods -n inference-prod` for OOMs and keep an eye on `metrics.queue.length` >5k. If queue grows >8k escalate to paging. Also follow runbook: /runbooks/gpu-autoscale-attachrole.

anita (support): Customers updated: ETA 45m for fully recovered capacity, incremental updates every 20m. Linking support tickets.

leo (mlops): Post-incident actions: 1) Add 10% buffer pool of pre-warmed GPU nodes in prod-east-1, 2) implement instance-profile backoff and pre-attach strategy, 3) validate launchtemplate user-data taint flows in CI, 4) autoscaler CA behavior change to handle API 429s gracefully. I'll own the evals/ML side.

mike (infra): AWS ticket opened: case #AWS-987654321, requesting temporary increase for AttachRole API for the account. Also filing infra change to add a second instance-profile and reuse existing LT versions instead of creating new LTs under pressure.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated (manual capacity + routing fallback). Postmortem assigned to leo (mlops) and mike (infra). Please capture timeline and permanent fixes. :thumbsup:

infra-oncall: Acknowledged handoff. I'll stay watch for next 2 hours and update if anything regresses.

anita (support): Closing immediate customer escalations; leaving tickets open pending final postmortem and followups.

sara (oncall): Final note: retrospective requires clarifying which systems can pre-warm instance profiles, and ensuring default ASG headroom. Thanks team. :heart:
